updates.finding: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted two drones launched toward Riyadh and two ballistic missiles launched toward Khamis Mushait. Civil-defence alerts had been issued overnight for Khamis Mushait and Abha. No casualties or damage from the intercepted weapons were established in the reviewed reporting.
updates.status: TWO DRONES AND TWO BALLISTIC MISSILES REPORTED INTERCEPTED BY SAUDI-LED COALITION; DAMAGE/CASUALTIES NOT ESTABLISHED
updates.drawer_effect: UPDATE Saudi-Houthi strike chronology with the Sep.26 early-morning salvo; preserve coalition attribution and absence of independent weapon-by-weapon verification.

updates.finding: Rashad al-Alimi, head of Yemen's internationally recognized Presidential Leadership Council, called for general mobilisation and urged Yemenis to join government armed and security forces through official channels. Reporting also said he announced a full pardon beginning Sep.26 for Houthi fighters and officials who defect to the government side.
updates.status: GENERAL MOBILIZATION CALL AND DEFECTION-AMNESTY OFFER PUBLICLY REPORTED; EFFECT ON MANPOWER OR TERRITORIAL CONTROL NOT YET OBSERVED
updates.drawer_effect: CREATE/UPDATE Yemen government mobilisation drawer; do not infer actual recruitment, defections or battlefield effect without subsequent evidence.

updates.finding: The Iraqi prime minister's office said Baghdad was in direct talks with Washington seeking exemptions for some Iraqi airports from U.S. restrictions affecting Iranian airlines so humanitarian, medical, education and religious travel could resume. This confirmed Iraqi implementation pressure while opening a waiver track; no exemption had been granted by the evidence horizon.
updates.status: IRAQI WAIVER REQUEST CONFIRMED; FLIGHT RESTRICTIONS STILL IN FORCE; U.S. EXEMPTION NOT YET GRANTED
updates.drawer_effect: UPDATE Iraq aviation-sanctions drawer from full suspension only to full suspension plus active humanitarian-waiver request; do not treat talks as an exemption.

updates.finding: Houthi-aligned Sanaa military leaders publicly claimed their missile and drone forces were ready for further escalation and threatened strikes on enemy military and economic interests. They rejected Saudi allegations concerning holy sites. The statements are retained as actor signaling, not proof of a specific executable strike plan or target set.
updates.status: HIGH-LEVEL HOUTHI ESCALATION RHETORIC CONFIRMED AS ACTOR CLAIM; SPECIFIC OPERATION OR TARGET EXECUTION NOT ESTABLISHED
updates.drawer_effect: UPDATE Houthi signaling watch; do not convert readiness rhetoric into a forecasted or confirmed operation.
